title: Architecture invariants
root_cause: Cohesion rules are documented but not enforced as one current-tree invariant gate.
source_requirement: Enforce semantic profile, revision, primitive owner, duplicate exception, evidence class, conformance, dependency, task-plan, model, release identity, and parent/child N/A invariants.
implementation_steps: Implement each mandated invariant with stable ID.
Bind every check to authoritative registry/source.
Register focused test and governed section owner.
negative_cases: Child control N/A promotes parent N/A.
affected_tests: Registry, generated artifact, release boundary, routing, skill, and coordination tests.
evidence_required: One failing and one passing vector for every invariant ID.
rollback: Remove gate registration while keeping individual validators available; do not claim repair freeze.
acceptance_criteria: All mandated invariants execute and return stable IDs.
Complete current tree passes before repair freeze.
